entities.name: St. Patrick's Cathedral, Bridgetown
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: St. Patrick's Cathedral, located in Bridgetown, Barbados, is the seat of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Bridgetown. It is one of two cathedrals in that territory, the other being the Anglican Cathedral of St. Michael.
